They are known to carry stronger pieces of [[Lizalfos Gear]], resulting in them being regarded as more dangerous. Like most Lizalfos, Black Lizalfos can be found swimming in bodies of [[Water (Terrain)|Water]], such as lakes or seas. | 100 % }} }} }} ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Compendium/Extract/TotK|Black Lizalfos}} Black Lizalfos appear in {{TotK}} with largely the same appearance as they have in {{BotW}}. The primary distinction is that they have larger, upright horns resembling notched blades. ==Other Appearances== ==={{CoH|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} In {{CoH}}, Black Lizalfos are stronger than [[Blue Lizalfos]] and [[Green Lizalfos]], possessing more health and attack power than their weaker counterparts. Unlike the Green Lizalfos, they wield spears that can hit [[Cadence]], [[Link]], [[Yves]] and [[Zelda]] at a farther distance. However, they do share the same beat pattern as other Lizalfos, standing still until the player walks in front of them, prompting them to charge forward. When attacking, they move in a straight line on every single beat until they collide into something, becoming stunned for three music beats and therefore vulnerable. If not slain within that period of time, they will regain consciousness on the fourth beat and either resume standing in one place or repeating their attack pattern. {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} {{Stub|AoC}} {{Noncanon|End}} ==={{AoI|-}}=== {{Checklist |game= AoI |type= Enemies |category= Enemies in Age of Imprisonment |needs= Detailed information on the following: * The Enemy's behavior * The Enemy's weaknesses }} {{Stub|AoI}} Black Lizalfos as they appeared in {{TotK}} return as [[Enemy|Enemies]] in {{AoI}}. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== {{All Images}} File:BotW Moblin and Lizalfos Concept Artwork.jpg|{{Game Label|{{BotW|-}}}}Concept artwork of a Black Lizalfos and other Monsters File:TotK Black Lizalfos Model 2.png|{{Game Label|{{TotK|-}}}}A Gloom-Wreathed Black Lizalfos File:CoH Black Lizalfos Sprite.png|{{Game Label|{{CoH|-}}}}A Black Lizalfos File:AoC Black Lizalfos Portrait Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Portrait of a Black Lizalfos ==See Also== {{See Also| * Enemy * Lizalfos * Monster }} {{Ref| {{Cite|'''Black Lizalfos'''|Hyrule Compendium|BotW}} {{Cite|These quick-witted, lizard-like monsters can be found all over Hyrule.
